C-71-OVERLAY-RESIZE.Name: Keep expanded tables centered when owning layout surfaces change late
C-71-OVERLAY-RESIZE.Summary: Investigate and repair the two C-71 WebKit centering failures (114.5px) observed in run 39252757178. The owning outline can become visible after initial table sizing without a column/window resize; available scroller geometry must remain current.
C-71-OVERLAY-RESIZE.ApprovalBasis: Owner approved finishing C-71 and desktop stabilization with sequential integrations. Existing C-71 R-1 requires centered expanded tables within the available owning editor viewport.

Goals.Goal: Refresh on owned scroller/outline layout changes and keep hidden/shown outline or sidebar transitions centered without Markdown writes.

Constraints.Constraint: Retain the 2px browser threshold, natural overflow, editor ownership and observer cleanup. No global DOM observer, release or source rewriting.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No new table sizing/persistence policy or broad renderer refactor.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Late outline/sidebar regressions reproduce before repair and pass in Chromium/WebKit; unit ownership/cleanup and existing table/viewer checks pass.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-012 resize surfaces and table viewport verification.
